## Purpose

Compute RNA velocity from an AnnData object containing cell-aligned spliced and
unspliced layers. The template uses the dynamical model from the source
workflow and saves the enriched AnnData object plus core metadata.

## Inputs and parameters

The input must have observations as cells, variables as genes, unique
identifiers, spliced and unspliced layers, and a usable representation.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scanpy as sc
import scvelo as scv

input_path = Path("input/velocity_input.h5ad")
output_path = Path("output/scvelo_output.h5ad")
metadata_path = Path("output/scvelo_metadata.tsv")
figure_path = Path("output/velocity_stream.png")

spliced_layer = "spliced"
unspliced_layer = "unspliced"
representation = "X_pca"
embedding = "umap"
color_key = "cluster"
min_shared_counts = 20
n_top_genes = 2000
n_pcs = 30
n_neighbors = 30
velocity_mode = "dynamical"
n_jobs = 1
seed = 1234
```

## Analysis

```{python}
adata = ad.read_h5ad(input_path)
if spliced_layer not in adata.layers or unspliced_layer not in adata.layers:
    raise ValueError("Input must contain spliced and unspliced AnnData layers.")
if (adata.layers[spliced_layer].shape != adata.shape or
        adata.layers[unspliced_layer].shape != adata.shape):
    raise ValueError("Kinetic layers must have the same cell-by-gene shape as AnnData.")
if not adata.obs_names.is_unique or not adata.var_names.is_unique:
    raise ValueError("AnnData observation and variable identifiers must be unique.")

if spliced_layer != "spliced":
    adata.layers["spliced"] = adata.layers[spliced_layer].copy()
if unspliced_layer != "unspliced":
    adata.layers["unspliced"] = adata.layers[unspliced_layer].copy()

scv.settings.set_figure_params(dpi=150, frameon=False)
scv.pp.filter_and_normalize(
    adata,
    min_shared_counts=min_shared_counts,
    n_top_genes=n_top_genes,
)

if representation not in adata.obsm:
    sc.tl.pca(adata, n_comps=n_pcs, random_state=seed)
    representation = "X_pca"

sc.pp.neighbors(
    adata,
    n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
    n_pcs=n_pcs,
    use_rep=representation,
    random_state=seed,
)
scv.pp.moments(
    adata,
    n_pcs=n_pcs,
    n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
)

if velocity_mode == "dynamical":
    scv.tl.recover_dynamics(adata, n_jobs=n_jobs)
scv.tl.velocity(adata, mode=velocity_mode)
scv.tl.velocity_graph(adata, n_jobs=n_jobs)
scv.tl.velocity_pseudotime(adata)
scv.tl.recover_latent_time(adata)
scv.tl.velocity_confidence(adata)

if f"X_{embedding}" not in adata.obsm:
    sc.tl.umap(adata, random_state=seed)
```

## Diagnostics

```{python}
figure_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
scv.pl.velocity_embedding_stream(
    adata,
    basis=embedding,
    color=color_key if color_key in adata.obs else None,
    show=False,
)
plt.savefig(figure_path, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close()
print(adata)
print(adata.obs[["velocity_pseudotime", "latent_time", "velocity_confidence"]].describe())
```

## Outputs

```{python}
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
metadata_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
adata.write_h5ad(output_path)
adata.obs.reset_index(names="cell_id").to_csv(metadata_path, sep="\t", index=False)
```

## Method notes

The source workflow reconstructs spliced/unspliced layers upstream. This
canonical input contract assumes those layers already exist and makes the
representation explicit. The neighborhood graph above is the representation
choice used by moments. Dynamical
velocity requires model recovery and is not equivalent to a stochastic or
deterministic run. Velocity vectors and latent time are directional hypotheses,
not proof of lineage.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Kinetic-layer warning

The `spliced` and `unspliced` layers must represent the kinetic quantities
expected by scVelo. Do not replace them with Harmony-corrected or other
batch-integrated expression matrices. An integrated representation may be used
for neighbors or visualization only when that choice is explicit and checked
against the velocity assumptions.
:::
